title: The Addition for Open TechWorks Work in a Circle Year's Credit
content:
## The addition for work the member has in hand

An addition is made to a Northbeam Circle Membership year's credit for work the member has open under
Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair. The standing of the agreement the profile holds and the labour
charged on it decide what is added.

| Standing of the agreement | Labour charged on it in the 12 months ending on the handling day | What is added |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | Some | The diagnostic fee figure of the service that agreement is handled under |
| Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | None | The least labour billed on that service at its labour rate |
| Any other standing | Any | Nothing |

## The clause in words

Where the agreement the profile holds stands scheduled, dispatched or held for parts and labour has been
charged on it in the twelve months ending on the handling day, the diagnostic fee figure of the service
that agreement is handled under is added. Where that agreement stands scheduled, dispatched or held for
parts and no labour has been charged on it in that window, the least labour billed on that service at its
labour rate is added. Where no agreement on the profile stands scheduled, dispatched or held for parts,
nothing is added for work in hand, and 0.00 goes into the year's credit on this account.

## What the two amounts are read from

Both amounts belong to the service the agreement is handled under rather than to the Circle tier: the
diagnostic fee figure recorded for that service, and the least labour that service bills, taken at its
labour rate. Neither is a figure of the membership.

## Input, judgement and outcome

A member with an agreement standing dispatched and 120.00 of labour already charged on it in the window
has the diagnostic fee figure of that service added. The same agreement with no labour charged in that
window has the least labour of that service, at its labour rate, added instead. An agreement standing
completed adds nothing, whatever labour stands on it.
